title: Outrigger beams.
officialText:
The fulcrum point of the beam shall rest on a secure bearing at least 6 inches (152 mm) in each
horizontal dimension. The beam shall be secured against movement and shall be securely braced against tipping at both the
fulcrum point and the inboard end.
